articles.summary: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. ("Edgewise" or the "Company"), (Nasdaq: EWTX), a leading clinical-stage cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, today announced that on October 30, 2026, Edgewise granted inducement stock options to purchase a total of 17,250 shares of Edgewise's common stock and awards of inducement restricted stock units (each, an "RSU award") covering a total of 8,626 shares of Edgewise's common stock to 2 new non-executive employees in connection with the commencement of their employment, pursuant to Edgewise's 2024 Inducement Equity Incentive Plan (the "Inducement Plan"). Each inducement stock option has an exercise price of $38.90 per share, which is equal to the closing price of a share of Edgewise common stock on the grant date, and shall vest as follows: 25% of the shares subject to such inducement stock option shall vest on the one year anniversary of the start date of each employee, and an additional one forty-eighth (1/48th) of the shares subject to such
articles.title: Edgewise Therapeutics Reports Inducement Grants as permitted by the Nasdaq Listing Rules
